status: frozen before any metric-human statistic was computed

design.unit: caption (one candidate per image; no system label released)
design.matcher: E1 COCO-80 CHAIR matcher (e1_chair_count.nodes), ordered distinct classes
design.gold: COCO-80 classes in the human reference(s) of the image
design.z_P: P_raw minus mean P_raw at the same M (registered G3 secondary count-matched estimator)
design.bootstrap: 2000 image-clustered multinomial resamples, seed 0, 95% percentile CI
deviations_from_DOCCI_G3: no within-system slope: system IDs not released, so (i) is a pooled slope
no 14-VLM ranking: (ii) is caption-level tau_b; matched-prefix MCP needs same-image pairs and is replaced by z_P
(iii) pairs are across images because each image has one candidate

frozen_predictions.i: beta_M (OLS slope of Relevance on M) < 0 AND bootstrap CI upper bound < 0
frozen_predictions.ii: delta_tau = tau_b(z_P,Rel) - tau_b(P_raw,Rel) >= ii_delta_tau_min AND bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
frozen_predictions.iii: acc_ceq(-CHAIR->Rel) - acc_cdiff(-CHAIR->Rel) > 0 AND bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
frozen_predictions.overall: PASS if i, ii, iii all pass; FAIL if none; else MIXED

kill_rules.ii: delta_tau <= 0 -> kill the claim that count-matched precision tracks LongCap-Arena Relevance better than raw precision
kill_rules.iii: diff <= 0 -> kill the claim that metric-human agreement is higher on count-equal pairs on LongCap-Arena

reporting: report whichever way it falls; secondary OLS (M + words + G) is descriptive only; Descriptiveness not tested
